name: Tor Linnorm
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 20 (Deactivated by Cold Iron)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Curse of Boiling Blood
defensiveAbilities.description:
When a creature slays the linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 48 Will Saving Throw save or gain weakness to fire 20 and Slowed 1 from the agonizing pain it now endures at all times, with an unlimited duration.

As long as a character continues to suffer this curse, its slowed condition can never be reduced below slowed 1.

Effect: Curse of Boiling Blood

defensiveAbilities.name: Lava Affinity
defensiveAbilities.description: A tor linnorm can breathe and swim freely while submerged in lava and magma.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(3d6+21) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 46 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pyroclastic Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The tor linnorm expels a 60ft Cone of flame and ash dealing 20d6 Fire Damage damage to creatures within the area (Basic DC 46 Reflex Saving Throw save).

The linnorm can't use Pyroclastic Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

At the start of the tor linnorm's next turn, the area of the Pyroclastic Breath is covered in thick, scorching smoke that burns both the lungs and eyes, dealing an additional 10d6 Fire Damage damage to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 46 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that spends an entire round in the smoke with open eyes must succeed at a Basic DC 44 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Blinded for 1 minute.

The smoke dissipates after 1 minute; in strong winds, the smoke dissipates in 5 rounds, and in more powerful winds, it may clear even more quickly.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slashing Claws
offensiveAbilities.description: The tor linnorm makes four Strikes with their claws, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the tor linnorm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the tor linnorm makes all their attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tor Linnorm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 44 Fortitude Saving Throw;

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 8d6 Fire Damage damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 12d6 Fire Damage damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead spend an action to use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

lv8spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
lv8spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

lv9spells.name: Unfettered Movement (Constant)
lv9spells.description: You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to Escape an effect that has them Immobilized, Grabbed, or Restrained, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.
